review.decision: Verify the same terminal-input layout contract in the production Go sender and DSH receiver.
review.notes: Owner review before the implementation. All fixtures live in a temporary HOME. The isolated proof cannot certify actual writer drain, service order or power-loss recovery. Scope uses the small agentclient test package with the shipped DSH module in a private fixture.

cases.description: Terminal input uses an explicitly bound layout across Go and DSH.
cases.setup: Private v1 queue with pending, unknown and accepted actions, installed copies of the shipped DSH plugin, a synthetic agent, and a private tmux stub.
cases.action: Check legacy and active layouts, preserve v1 entries after changing the layout, retry by the same ID, and change or remove the journal while a writer is prepared. Check missing, prepared, malformed, foreign identity and unmatched receiver generation.
cases.expected: Both consumers agree on the selected directory. Valid legacy input and accepted receipts survive. Active generations retain pending and unknown authority. Unverified layout and stale operations refuse without creating a new request or changing a receipt.
